---
applyTo: "kb/people/**/*.md"
---
# kb/people/<slug>/ — 1-1 history
Dated files (`<date>.md`) are handoffs from the M365 1-1 Prep agent or the user's own reports; do not edit them.
`profile.md` (optional, editable): `# <Name>` then `role:`, `since:`, `## Standing topics` (bullets), `## Their goals as they stated them` (bullets, dated), `## How they like to work` (bullets). Nothing about health, personal life or performance ratings — this is preparation context, not a personnel file.
A prep summary written locally by `/prep-1-1` goes to `<date>.prep.md` with sections: `## Last meetings` (dates + one line each), `## Open follow-ups` (table `| raised on | follow-up | status |`), `## My open actions` (table `| raised on | action | due | status |`), `## Suggested agenda` (3–5 numbered items, the colleague's items first), `## If the agenda is empty` (one line: propose to cancel or to keep as a short check-in — the user decides).
